hints.title: Lookup and Ordering Hybrid
hints.text: Fast identifier lookups paired with prioritised execution require separating direct retrieval from ordered ranking.

hints.title: Ordered Storage
hints.text: Use a balanced BST or a priority queue with lazy deletion to maintain sorted order.

hints.title: Lazy Invalidation
hints.text: When updating or deleting tasks, register changes in the map and lazily pop stale entries during execTop.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Add, edit, remove, and execute operations run in logarithmic amortized time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning full task arrays upon every top query yields linear query time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary memory pairs lookup hash map with priority queue.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs composite data structure balancing O(1) key lookups with O(log n) ordered retrieval.
